purpose: Matched national-profile evaluation of the validation-selected CVAE, current XGBoost/seasonal block-bootstrap generator, original H2RES fixed-input baseline, and separately retained original CVAE reference.
primary_ae_selection: Existing validation-only recommendation; never reselect using this benchmark.
hybrid_configuration: Exact current source and default fitting/calibration/generation functions; CPU n_jobs=1 and explicitly recorded random_state are the only estimator parameter overrides. Full drift calibration, no fast calibration, no hyperparameter tuning.

consumer_cpu_training_measurement.status: Deferred: both local attempts stopped before completing fitting to preserve other laptop work

central_profile_rule: Average the same 15 generated paths for each trained generator, then repeat that central calendar profile over each reporting year. Never substitute these metrics for individual-trajectory quality.
historical_baseline: Capacity-weighted solar/onshore-wind profiles from the original shared H2RES files, repeated annually. Original H2RES has no trained ambient-temperature generator; training-only hourly temperature climatology is an explicit proxy.
resource_reporting: Record wall time and sampled process RSS/Windows peak working set for fit, full calibration, generation and whole process. Compare fixed-architecture AE 900-second CPU run and hybrid fitting on the same laptop; existing faculty GPU-reference/selected checkpoint costs remain separate hardware rows. No solver time is included.
limitations: The reporting period and previous CVAE results have already been seen. This is a new frozen comparison, not a new pristine test set.
No new model or hyperparameter choice is selected from reporting outcomes.
The selected CVAE is best among previously tested eligible configurations under the stated budget, not a globally proven optimal autoencoder.
The hybrid deliberately models channels independently; cross-channel results are diagnostics, not a claim of coherent joint weather probabilities.
Historical H2RES assets and the national climate source have different spatial/source construction, so the baseline comparison includes input-representation effects.
No Gurobi run, original production overwrite, external publication or message is authorized by this comparison.
Resource limits are a hypothesis to assess, not a required conclusion. Failure of a generator or superiority of the hybrid is not assumed.
